description:
Create a new authorization request. Authorizations grant permission to send confirmations to a user via a specific channel. The user must approve the authorization before confirmations can be sent.

ACCESS: needs a Proof account. Authenticate this client (Claude Code: /mcp → Authenticate), then call this tool again. start_login does NOT open this tool.

bsuid.description: WhatsApp Business-Scoped User ID (alternative to phone for WhatsApp channel)

business_name.description: Business name displayed to user during authorization

expires_in.description: Expiry in seconds (max 90 days, default 90 days)

hitl_id.description: HITL configuration ID to link this authorization to

phone.description: Target phone number in E.164 format (e.g., +15551234567)

recipient.description: Channel-specific recipient identifier (chat_id for Telegram, phone/BSUID for WhatsApp)

name: create_authorization
